params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-apppaths-inspect'
if (Test-Path $root) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $root }
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $root | Out-Null
git -C $root grep -n "AppPaths" -- "*.cs"
git -C $root grep -n "MHW_MANAGER_HOME\|MOD_MANAGER_HOME" -- "*.cs"
